title: Explore Rajasthan (with Tanot Mata Temple)
shortDescription: The land of desert and experience the chilly winds of the Thar Desert with an exclusive tent stay at Jaisalmer, along with experiencing the land of royalty, the Blue City of Rajasthan – Jodhpur.
description: The land of desert and experience the chilly winds of the Thar Desert with an exclusive tent stay at Jaisalmer, along with experiencing the land of royalty, the Blue City of Rajasthan – Jodhpur. This tour offers you a perfect mix of majestic Jodhpur forts with the unending beauty of the Thar Desert, rich culture, and heritage, along with a Longewala visit.

Rajasthan, also referred to as the “Desert Capital of India,” is all about vivid colors, monuments, music, and dance. If you want to see the best of the two desert cities, Jodhpur and Jaisalmer, take this journey, which is flawlessly planned to give you the best travel experience to visit the Thar Desert.

itinerary.title: Arrive Jodhpur / Transfer to Hotel
itinerary.description: On arrival at Jodhpur Airport, pick up and transfer to your hotel. The rest of the day is at leisure to self-explore the city on your own.

itinerary.title: In Jodhpur – Full Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Today morning, after breakfast, we will proceed for a city tour of the Blue City. We visit Mehrangarh Fort, the most famous Jodhpur attraction. It spreads over 5 kms and stands atop a high hill. Within the fort, we see notable beautiful structures like Moti Mahal and Phool Mahal. After visiting the fort, we will visit Jaswant Thada, a beautiful white marble memorial built by Sardar Singh in 1899 in memory of Maharaja Jaswant Singh II. Later, we will visit the Clock Tower and spend some time in nearby local markets to enjoy last-minute shopping before returning to the hotel.

itinerary.title: Drive to Jaisalmer Sam Sand Dunes (325 Kms/ 6–7 Hrs)
itinerary.description: Today morning, after breakfast, check out from the hotel and drive to Jaisalmer Sam Sand Dunes – the Golden City of Rajasthan. On arrival at the camp, we experience thrilling dune bashing (optional at extra cost) over the golden sands of Jaisalmer. Late evening, we get an opportunity to witness the spectacular beauty of the sandy terrain by taking a joyful camel ride and viewing the red-orange color splash of sunset on the desert horizon. Overnight stay in tent at Sam Sand Dunes, Jaisalmer.

itinerary.title: Drive to Longewala & Tanot Mata Temple and Return to Jaisalmer City
itinerary.description: Today early morning, we will check out from the camp and drive towards the Indo-Pak Border to see the Longewala War Museum and Tanot Mata Temple. After a full-day trip to the Indo-Pak Border, we will return to Jaisalmer City. Note - Indian nationals with proper Indian IDs are only allowed to visit the Indo-Pak Border and Tanot Mata Temple.

itinerary.title: In Jaisalmer – Full Day Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Today, after breakfast, we will proceed to explore Jaisalmer City. Visit the Golden Fort – a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the very few living forts in the world, as nearly one-fourth of the city’s population still resides within the fort, followed by a visit to Patwon Ki Haveli Museum – a palace built in the early 1800s, now a museum featuring intricate carvings, furniture, and artwork, and see Saleem Ji Ki Haveli and Gadisar Lake.
